ZXing.Net
Upstream: https://github.com/micjahn/ZXing.Net
License: Apache License 2.0; see ZXing-LICENSE.txt and source file notices.
Vendored Source/lib files selected by upstream zxing.net4.0.csproj, downloaded
6 October 2026. Upstream source assembly version: 0.17.0.0.
The exact upstream commit was not retained; the supplied source files and
SHA256SUMS.txt identify this vendored snapshot. No download is needed to build.

Local compatibility changes for the .NET Framework C# 5 compiler:
- GenericGF.cs: binary integer literals converted to decimal equivalents.
- StringRenderer.cs: property initializers moved into constructor;
  expression-bodied member converted to a method body.
- QRCodeWriter.cs: nameof(code) replaced by the literal "code".
- qrcode/encoder/Encoder.cs: null-conditional encoding.WebName access expanded.

Build zxing.dll from the supplied source with scripts/build-zxing.ps1.
ND LabelDesigner uses offline 1D, QR, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417 and GS1 encoding.
Local functional change (2026-11-17): DataMatrixWriter.cs uses ECC200 ASCII
encoding for GS1 compact-mode requests, with leading/separator FNC1 and digit
pairs. This avoids implicit-unlatch corruption on short GS1 fields in the
vendored minimal encoder. Ordinary Data Matrix encoding is unchanged.
See docs/BARCODE_CATALOG.md for limits. Barcode decoding is used by tests;
the bundled library does not provide a Plessey decoder.

Source Sans 3 is bundled separately under the SIL Open Font License:
assets/fonts/OFL.txt. No fonts or resources are downloaded at application startup.
